title: Le Chevalier D'Eon — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Le Chevalier D'Eon — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Le Chevalier D'Eon (Japanese: シュヴァリエ, Hepburn: Shuvarie; (French "Chevalier"), literally "Knight") is a Japanese anime television series produced by Production I.G based on an original story by Tow Ubukata. The anime originally aired in Japan on WOWOW from August 19, 2006, to February 2, 2007.

Every serious account of Le Chevalier D'Eon eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. The series' soundtrack was released by BMG Japan (now known as Sony BMG) on November 22, 2006. The soundtrack features twenty-eight tracks of background music used in the series as well as the short versions of the opening and ending themes.
